description: The unified search results page displays all matching records across multiple entity types, including Partners, Contacts, and Interactions. It supports a tabbed view to categorize results by entity type, along with global filtering options to refine searches.

pages.name: SearchResultComponent
pages.description: This page provides a consolidated view of search results from various parts of the system, such as Partners, Contacts, and Interactions. Users can quickly navigate through different entity types using dedicated tabs and apply global filters to narrow down their search.

search.placeholder: Search for partners, contacts, or interactions...
search.description: This search bar allows you to perform a unified search across all major entity types (Partners, Contacts, Interactions) to quickly find relevant records.
search.help_text: Enter keywords, names, or IDs. Results will appear categorized by entity type. You can refine your search by using global filters.

help_guidance.when_stuck: Use the search box in the header to perform searches. Results are automatically categorized by entity type (Partners, Contacts, Interactions). Click on tabs to view specific entity types. Enable global filters if you want to restrict search to your organization or specific criteria.
common_tasks: Searching across all entities: Use the main search box, results appear automatically
Viewing specific entity results: Click on tabs (Partners, Contacts, Interactions)
Applying global filters: Toggle the global filter switch to restrict to your org unit
Opening a record: Click on any search result card to navigate to the detailed view
Refining search: Modify your search query in the header search box
troubleshooting: Problem: No results found for your query. → Solution: Try broadening your search terms or checking for typos. Ensure you are searching for existing data.
Problem: Results are not what I expected. → Solution: Check if global filters are enabled, which might be restricting your results. Try disabling them to see more comprehensive results.
help_guidance.getting_started: To begin, use the search bar located at the top of the page. Type in keywords related to the partner, contact, or interaction you are looking for. The system will automatically display results categorized by entity type. Click on any result to view its full details.
keyboard_shortcuts: Enter: Execute search query after typing in the search bar.
Tab: Navigate between elements on the search results page.
Ctrl + F (or Cmd + F on Mac): Find specific text within the current search results page.
